about_the_game:
Chamrosh is hack-n-slash Action game that came from Persian mythology.where players assume the role of FEREYDOUN in his quest to hunt down and dispose of demons in his way to find Chamrosh.

ENTER THE WORLD OF CHAMROSH


almost thousand years ago , A Covenant was made Chamrosh Legendary Champion have been choose to protect Persia Nation to eternity, the other Legends called gods and Kaveh the blacksmith made an spell on him to make him immortal but this curse will turn him to stone and only kaveh’s blood and anahita’s feather will turn him back to life again.
After a long time persia needs chamrosh again to fight against Greece’s army in this 600 YO war and finish this, but even gods without chamrosh couldn’t go into the world of chamrosh and only kaveh’s bloodline can go, so keyumars the last generation of kaveh have been sent to the world of chamrosh to turn him back to life again but he have been ambushed on the way and couldn’t make it.
But there was another person with kaveh’s bloodline, a kid, named fereydoun son of keyumars , the child grown up with gods, in many years they taught fereydoun how to fight and slay, now is the time to send him to the world of chamrosh…

PLAY AS A HIGHLY TRAINED DEMON SLAYER


Start your destiny with Fereydoun son of Kiamars, the latest generation of Kaveh the blacksmith, who is the last person that can turn Chamrosh alive.he is traveling to Chamrosh's world for the first time and will fight with orcs and demons .he is looking for who killed his father and his vengeance for Loss of his father makes him angry and wants to revenge.

meet elder gods and legends
for the first time we brings Persian elder gods and their powers in this game,you can see who they are and their abilities.they will help you in this journey and will give you their powers.listen to them,they will guide you,and you can meet Persian legendary warriors and kings of history.

KEY FEATURES

  • Striking visuals enhanced with unreal engine 5 and makes game looks amazing and beautiful with new lighting system.
  • Engage in devastating boss battles against the mighty ِDemons and Orcs
  • Rage attribute to slash more enemies by getting gods power.
  • Fantasy mythological world filled with ferocious monsters from Persian Mythology.
  • Epic environments
  • Metahuman characters

Developer Team


this trailer is just a preview and will change in final release,we will try our best to fix all the bugs and improve animations and performance until final release and make you feel amazing.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Violence,killing, Blood and Gore, Strong Language
